hybrid-memory.reason: A schema of typed, linked context records, which is close to a typed-record memory graph.

hybrid-memory.quote: useful checklist when evaluating any context graph or agent memory system's claims
hybrid-memory.reason: Lists hard problems for graph-based memory (forgetting, staleness, canonicalization, storage design) that can be used to check a memory system's design.

hybrid-memory.reason: A reference recipe for combining lexical and embedding search, with measured gains.
